trips.title: LA to Las Vegas and back in a Rivian: a two-day sample plan
trips.intro: Two driving days and two nights in Las Vegas, 530 miles in all, from Pasadena and home again. Day one stops once, at the Rivian Adventure Network site in Barstow, and ends at a Las Vegas hotel with a Level 2 charger; over the stay, charging at 6 kW adds about 79 kWh and stops at 90%. The drive home needs only a short top-up at Primm. Times, charge levels and costs are estimates for the sample truck, and the hotel is a sample stop with a Level 2 charger, not a real listing; on a real trip, check a hotel's charger before you rely on it.
trips.blurb: Los Angeles to Las Vegas and back in two days: a hotel overnight on Level 2, one fast-charge stop each way.

trips.title: Pasadena to San Francisco in a Rivian: I-5 with one stop
trips.intro: The classic I-5 run: 381 miles from the Rose Bowl to the Ferry Building in about 5 h 40 min of driving, about 6 h 15 min with the stop. Leaving at 90%, the plan makes one fast-charge stop at Harris Ranch, arriving at 18% and charging to 80% in about 36 minutes using a NACS adapter, then reaches San Francisco with 16% left. Every figure is the planner's estimate for the sample truck; your truck, the weather and the charger on the day will change them.
trips.blurb: Pasadena to San Francisco on I-5: 381 miles with one fast-charge stop at Harris Ranch.

trips.title: LA to Mammoth Lakes in a Rivian: one stop to the mountains
trips.intro: From Union Station to Mammoth Mountain Main Lodge at about 9,000 feet: 314 miles. The plan stops once on the way, at the TA Travel Center fast chargers, charging from 22% to 78% in about 33 minutes with a NACS adapter, and arrives with 16%. This sample plan does not model the climb; when you plan a real trip with your Rivian connected, the route comes from Rivian's planner and Rivolt adjusts for the forecast weather along the route, which matters on a winter run to the mountains. All figures are estimates for the sample truck.
trips.blurb: Los Angeles to Mammoth Lakes: 314 miles to the mountains with one fast-charge stop.
